items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So I married this other woman down there--Lou...uh, Geraldine Brown.

ctx.x: Okay, we won't worry about it. I guess it's all right. I don't see it registering. Okay.

So, we got a divorce. We got a divorce, an' about two years later, I run into a woman called Geraldine Brown. She was a sister of Joe Brown, the prizefighter in New Orleans. So we bounce aroun' for 'bout a coupla years. I went up an' left New Orleans, went back to Chicago, try to get my wife back. That didn't work. So I went back down a' New Orleans. So I married this other woman down there--Lou...uh, Geraldine Brown. So, in a coupla years, we had a little boy. He had heart trouble, an' he lived five years, an'…
